## History

Carrie Mott was a young girl whose father forbade her from attending evening concerts, holding the same views on the matter as [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P33](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0033)_
